snippet.title: AirAttack 2 - WW2 Shmup
snippet.description:
Mac: http://itunes.apple.com/app/id842246181
Steam Greenlight: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=865298457
iOS: http://itunes.apple.com/app/id842617644
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ArtInGames.AirAttack2f

The sequel of Award Winning next-gen top down air combat shooter with stunning 3D graphics and an amazing orchestral soundtrack.
Enjoy the classic atmosphere of WW2 arcade shoot-'em-ups in modern rendering.
Prepare your plane, level up your pilot and destroy the axis of evil with Flamethrower, Tail Gunner, Bombs, ...
Show your friends no mercy in the daily events!

Features:
* 22 campaign missions + survival mission
* Fully destructible 3D environment
* Orchestral soundtrack with 30 unique tracks
* Daily Events with rewards
* 5 Player Planes
* Plane Upgrades: Flamethrower, Tail Gunner, Bombs, Lasers, Wingmen, Homing Rockets, ...
* Amazing Lighting and Explosion Effects
* Landscape / Portrait orientation
* Android: support for Android TV, S-Pen, Gamepad, Mouse, Keyboard, NVIDIA Shield
* iOS: support for MFi, iCade
* Mac: Keyboard, Mouse, Gamepad

Follow us on facebook :)
https://www.facebook.com/AirAttack-2-283860965112042/
